Episodes.Title: Big in Japan
Episodes.Actors: An Swartenbroekx, Ann Tuts, Loes van den Heuvel
Episodes.Plot: Boma wants to conquer Japan and launches a new creation: the Boma Sushi sausage.

Episodes.Title: Soirée privée
Episodes.Actors: An Swartenbroekx, Ann Tuts, Loes van den Heuvel
Episodes.Plot: Pascale and Maurice want to close the café one more day every week. De Kampioenen aren't happy with this. Meanwhile Xavier is looking for an extra job.

Episodes.Title: Schwalbe
Episodes.Actors: An Swartenbroekx, Ann Tuts, Loes van den Heuvel
Episodes.Plot: Fernand needs the Kampioenen to move some things in his store. When it seems that nobody wants to help, he says that he hurt his back very much. Meanwhile Pascale thinks that Xavier is falling in love with her.

Episodes.Title: De Boma Boulevard
Episodes.Actors: An Swartenbroekx, Ann Tuts, Loes van den Heuvel
Episodes.Plot: A street is to be named after Boma. Boma insists on this since his rival Jean-Luc Grootjans already had a plaza named after him. Marc has to lend Boma a hand.

Episodes.Title: Wie wordt de vrouw van Boma?
Episodes.Actors: An Swartenbroekx, Ann Tuts, Loes van den Heuvel
Episodes.Plot: Boma accepts his sister Bertha's proposal to run a reindeer farm in Canada. De Kampioenen are against this plan and do everything to stop him. De Kampioenen search for a spouse through a battle to elect 'Mrs. Boma'.

Episodes.Title: Love Is in the Air
Episodes.Actors: An Swartenbroekx, Ann Tuts, Loes van den Heuvel
Episodes.Plot: Marc's customized light-blue classic Fiat 500 is tore up. Bieke wants to buy a new, more spacious family car. Eventually, Marc buys a new classic Fiat 500 behind Bieke's back. Meanwhile, Boma keeps trying to win Goedele's heart.
